body:
Well, this is very much a work in progress. I haven't even pushed all my local commits. FWIW, my latest iteration looks like this:
```sh
__zle_keymap_select=${widgets[zle-keymap-select]#user:}
```

I didn't choose `__starship` prefix because it has been used exclusively for things **added** by Starship itself.

body:
The reason recommended it because, `__zle_keymap_select` is too generic. Another tool can try to do the same thing and use the same variable name, and that could mess with starship's intialization.

But prefixing it with `__starship` brings down that possibility to almost zero.

body:
Maybe it can use [`add-zsh-hook` module](https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/User-Contributions.html#Manipulating-Hook-Functions) of zsh, this method is also recommended by [zsh official theme document](https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/User-Contributions.html#Writing-Themes). 
Using this method is good for implementation of https://github.com/starship/starship/issues/1994 as well.
